ideas.truth: A bag stops being furniture and becomes desirable the instant light reveals what it's made of.
ideas.moment: The bag sits in shadow, then a shaft of warm light sweeps across it, hardware and texture catching fire, right before it's grabbed and carried out the door.
ideas.key_frame: Extreme macro on the zipper pull and hardware, warm light just beginning to cross it, background dark and soft.

ideas.truth: First-day energy needs a bag that keeps pace with the rush.
ideas.moment: A hand reaches into frame, grips the strap, and lifts the bag off the table into motion toward the door.
ideas.key_frame: A hand entering from frame-right closing around the strap, bag mid-lift.

ideas.truth: Packing well is its own small satisfaction before any trip begins.
ideas.moment: The zipper is pulled shut in one clean motion, sealing everything in with a decisive snap.
ideas.key_frame: Close-up on the zipper pull mid-travel, fabric taut on either side.

why: It's the only idea buildable purely from one still photo without inventing a person, a hand, or an action the reference can't support — safest and strongest fit for image-to-video-from-a-still with product fidelity intact.
treatment: One continuous 6-second shot, no cuts, no people. We open on an extreme macro of the bag's zipper pull and hardware sitting in shadow. The camera smoothly pulls back as a single warm shaft of light sweeps left to right across the bag's surface in sync with the reveal, catching texture and metal in a brief flare. The full bag is revealed standing centered against a soft, muted background, then the camera settles to a static hold. Sound is ambient only — quiet room tone and a light metallic tick as the flare crosses the hardware. No dialogue. The final frame is the bag, fully lit, centered, still — clean space around it for brand text and CTA to be added afterward.

scenes.prompt: Camera starts in extreme macro on the zipper pull and hardware, then smoothly pulls back to reveal the full bag centered in frame. A warm light sweeps once across the surface as the camera settles into a static hold.
scenes.first_frame_still_prompt: Extreme macro shot of the bag's zipper pull and adjacent hardware, sitting in soft shadow, background dark and out of focus, calm and still just before the reveal begins.
scenes.S2_first_frame: Tight, shadowed macro on the zipper/hardware — already implies something worth waiting to see fully.
scenes.S3_one_action: One coordinated reveal action: a continuous camera pull-back from macro to full shot, synchronized with a single light sweep across the bag's surface, ending in a static hold — over 6 seconds.
scenes.S4_new_information: We learn what the bag actually looks like in full, and that it's built well enough to reward a close look — the previous frame withheld this on purpose.
scenes.S5_impact: The reveal lands on a bright, still, centered hero frame with clean negative space; big enough to read as a scroll-stopping product beat on a phone, and it leaves the exact end-frame needed for a CTA overlay.

finish.copy_placement: Hook line (no exclamation marks) appears as on-screen text in the upper third from ~0.5s, out of the way of the hardware and light flare; brand wordmark placed lower-third, present from first frame through to the end card so it reads with sound off; CTA text appears only in the final 1.5s over the still hero frame.
finish.end_card: Hold on the final still hero frame (bag centered, fully lit) with brand wordmark and a short CTA ('Shop now' or equivalent) added as code-generated text — no new visual element introduced.
finish.music: Yes — a soft, minimal, premium ambient bed with a gentle swell timed to the light sweep, resolving to a quiet hold on the final still frame.
